correctness.rationale: The exact piecewise line-length function has one strictly increasing and one strictly decreasing offset branch, which algebraically inverts to the entire survival law. Conjugate-radical bounds prove subcritical moment convergence; the rescaled grazing profile and integrable p>2 majorant yield the exact coefficient and conditional uniform law. Squared lengths reduce by explicit integration by parts to complete elliptic integrals, whose second-order expansions give the logarithmic constant. The actual packaged standalone checker passes 115 deterministic tests, supplemental only.
